scenarios.title: Identical inputs make no new model request

gherkin.given: a prior run has accepted outcomes for the current evidence and policy
gherkin.when: the same generation window is processed again
gherkin.then: the runtime records reuse and makes zero new model requests

obligations.requiredProof: A repeated run writes only a reuse reference, then a fresh manifest read resolves the same accepted outcome with no duplicate body or accepted outcome.
The real bounded adapter process records zero invocations while the production run graph reaches validated reuse.
The production run executes the frozen policy and owner reuse mode when deciding whether every semantic intent is reusable.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Perturb one frozen evidence fingerprint while retaining the prior outcome. The run must stop classifying the stage as exact reuse and the zero-adapter assertion must fail.

scenarios.plannedTest: tests/distributed-briefs.scheduler.e2e.mjs#Regression: repeated and resumed runs never repeat accepted semantic work

scenarios.title: Routine evidence avoids frontier synthesis

gherkin.given: admissible evidence changed without a material conflict
gherkin.then: no frontier request occurs and all publication checks still apply

obligations.requiredProof: The closed classifier and route planner transform the frozen routine facts into a non-frontier route under the declared unique ordinal.
The isolated run graph persists zero frontier dispatches and the accepted publication rereads through the existing validators.
Only the selected economical adapter receives the bounded request and the frontier adapter process records zero calls.
The production run executes the committed route ordinal, capability, privacy, materiality, and budget policy rather than a test-supplied route.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Mutate the routine frontier-rejection branch in the ephemeral test copy. A frontier call or an accepted frontier plan must make the route, receipt, and publication assertions fail.

scenarios.plannedTest: tests/distributed-briefs.final.e2e.mjs#Regression: runBriefRefresh enforces routine, material, and unmeasurable route outcomes

scenarios.title: Material evidence earns one frontier request

gherkin.given: deterministic analysis identifies a material evidence conflict
gherkin.then: exactly one frontier request may occur against a bounded projection

obligations.requiredProof: Only material or owner-permitted conflicted final synthesis satisfies every frontier eligibility predicate.
The run ledger persists one consumed frontier permit and one authoritative accepted or refused occurrence across reread.
The bounded frontier adapter receives one projection and a second attempted dispatch is refused before adapter entry.
The production run executes the committed one-per-run frontier permit and final-synthesis-only rule.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Mutate the frontier-permit consumed predicate in the ephemeral test copy, attempt a second dispatch, and require the adapter call count and ledger cardinality assertions to fail.

scenarios.plannedTest: tests/distributed-briefs.final.e2e.mjs#Regression: runBriefRefresh enforces routine, material, and unmeasurable route outcomes

scenarios.title: Unmeasurable configured cost blocks dispatch

gherkin.given: a selected paid route cannot measure a configured cost dimension
gherkin.then: the run refuses before any provider request

obligations.requiredProof: Admission returns B030-BUDGET-UNMEASURABLE with the missing dimension and records no provider request or synthetic zero usage.
The production pre-dispatch path executes the configured cap and the adapter's frozen measurable-dimension declaration.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Mutate the measurable-dimension eligibility check in the ephemeral test copy. Any provider-process entry or numeric zero receipt must fail the refusal and zero-call assertions.

scenarios.plannedTest: tests/distributed-briefs.final.e2e.mjs#Regression: runBriefRefresh enforces routine, material, and unmeasurable route outcomes

scenarios.title: Exhausted budget preserves current publication

gherkin.given: the remaining budget cannot cover a required stage
gherkin.then: the run refuses and the current publication remains unchanged

obligations.requiredProof: An isolated current pointer and freshness value are read before admission and reread byte-identical after refusal, with no partial history append.
The run records B030-BUDGET-EXHAUSTED and does not publish a candidate, substitute usage, or alternate success.
The production ledger executes the frozen remaining budget and worst-permitted stage vector atomically.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Mutate the cap-plus-one reservation rejection in the ephemeral test copy. Any dispatch, pointer change, or history append must fail the byte-identity and call-count assertions.

scenarios.plannedTest: tests/distributed-briefs.final.e2e.mjs#Regression: budget route and contract failures cannot switch providers or move current

scenarios.title: Provider failure does not switch routes

gherkin.given: the policy selected one eligible route
gherkin.then: the stage records a refusal and no alternate provider is selected

obligations.requiredProof: The selected real adapter boundary records the failure and every other registered adapter records zero entry.
The stage records B030-ROUTE-UNAVAILABLE with no substitute candidate or provider identity.
The production runtime retains the frozen selected capability, adapter config fingerprint, occurrence, and retry policy across failure.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Mutate the no-reroute branch in the ephemeral test copy and make the selected adapter unavailable. Any alternate adapter entry must fail the complete adapter-call ledger assertion.

scenarios.plannedTest: tests/distributed-briefs.final.e2e.mjs#Regression: budget route and contract failures cannot switch providers or move current

scenarios.title: Source instructions remain inert

gherkin.given: acquired source text requests a new tool, provider, or budget
gherkin.when: a semantic stage consumes the evidence projection
gherkin.then: the request remains data and cannot alter the run contract

obligations.requiredProof: Instruction-shaped content is rejected with B030-INJECTION and no candidate, log, or artifact contains the unsafe body.
The actual acquisition-to-author boundary passes only the bounded normalized projection and grants no model web, shell, write, tool, provider, or publication authority.
The production route, budget, tool, retry, output, and consequence policies remain byte-identical before and after hostile content processing.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Mutate the inert-content validator in the ephemeral test copy and inject route, tool, provider, budget, publication, and consequence fields. Acceptance of any field must fail the contract-byte and authority assertions.

scenarios.plannedTest: tests/distributed-briefs.final.e2e.mjs#Regression: hostile and incomplete evidence stays inert and visible through shadow comparison

scenarios.title: Invalid stage output cannot publish

gherkin.given: a semantic stage returns output outside its closed contract
gherkin.then: validation rejects the run and advances no current pointer

obligations.requiredProof: The current pointer and history are reread unchanged after malformed output reaches the real all-source and payload validators.
The run records B030-VALIDATION and cannot convert malformed output into partial, repaired, or accepted publication data.
The production run executes the declared output contract and existing payload validator without a cheaper-route exception.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Mutate the required-stage contract rejection in the ephemeral test copy and return a malformed candidate. Any pointer movement or validator success must fail the persisted-state assertions.

scenarios.plannedTest: tests/distributed-briefs.final.e2e.mjs#Regression: budget route and contract failures cannot switch providers or move current

scenarios.title: Recovery reuses accepted work

gherkin.given: a run stopped after accepted exact-input stage outcomes
gherkin.then: accepted outcomes are reused and only unresolved work may dispatch

obligations.requiredProof: After interruption, a manifest reread resolves each accepted occurrence unchanged and writes only outcomes for previously unresolved stages.
The real adapter call ledger shows zero repeat calls for accepted stages and calls only for unresolved stages.
Resume revalidates the frozen policy, input, adapter config, output contract, and retry profile before dispatch.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Perturb one accepted stage input identity before resume. That stage must become unresolved, and its adapter call must distinguish the control from exact accepted reuse.

scenarios.title: Missing evidence stays missing

gherkin.given: a required claim lacks admissible evidence
gherkin.then: the gap remains explicit and unsupported material claims cannot publish

obligations.requiredProof: The isolated run graph persists the named missing evidence state and no unsupported material claim enters current publication or history.
Missing, stale, conflicting, unsupported, and unavailable remain distinct; no model prose becomes evidence or a plausible positive claim.
The existing all-source and payload validators execute unchanged authority checks for every route class.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Mutate the admissible-evidence guard in the ephemeral test copy and let model prose fill a missing claim. Any accepted claim, pointer movement, or collapsed missing-state label must fail.

scenarios.title: Shadow evaluation exposes quality regressions

gherkin.given: baseline and candidate policies process the same frozen corpus
gherkin.then: every omission, unsupported claim, citation break, and miss is visible

obligations.requiredProof: Equivalent frozen baseline and candidate records produce complete deterministic differences for every critical quality class and measured cost dimension.
The immutable evaluation record rereads with all omissions, unsupported claims, citation breaks, conflicts, misses, validator results, and usage totals preserved.
The corpus manifest names at least thirty accepted run identities, every required stratum, one rubric version, and exact baseline/candidate refs.
The production evaluator executes the committed sample floor, strata, quality classes, configured measurement requirements, and promotion matrix.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Mutate one comparison branch at a time in the ephemeral test copy to omit an unsupported claim, citation break, conflict, or miss. The corresponding complete-difference assertion must fail.

scenarios.plannedTest: tests/distributed-briefs.final.e2e.mjs#Regression: hostile and incomplete evidence stays inert and visible through shadow comparison

scenarios.title: Public access survives generation failure

gherkin.given: a reader has no provider key or account
gherkin.then: the last validated brief remains readable with its original freshness

obligations.requiredProof: The production brief route visibly renders the prior validated content and original freshness after the latest run refuses.
No failed candidate, newer generation timestamp, invented freshness, login wall, provider prompt, or blank state replaces the current brief.
The routed publisher and current static reader agree on the same validated payload, content identity, freshness, and failure preservation.
A real same-origin static server serves the committed current payload and reader resources while provider access and account state are absent.
The current brief retains visible freshness, keyboard order, accessibility semantics, sourced claims, dark states, and scorecard content on the production route.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Mutate the isolated current pointer to the refused candidate or replace the stored freshness. The visible content, accessibility, pointer-parity, and original-freshness assertions must fail.
